name: Mare
source:
Silent to a fault. Mare is well known as an undefeatable bounty hunter. No one seems to know the exact reason Mare is aboard the Mothership. What lies beneath that mysterious powered exoskeleton?

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
